dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do we have anything more ordinary around here?

dialogues.speaker: Yantasar
dialogues.text: Sorry. I was silent for a long time just now, wasn't I? I just... couldn't really imagine what an ordinary drink would look like.

dialogues.speaker: Yantasar
dialogues.text: Does... soup count as a drink? Here's one I made with an ordinary recipe. It should be fine, right?
